# Praxia Labs — Complete Technical Specifications & Architecture (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
Praxia Labs (https://praxialabs.com) develops custom autonomous AI agent systems and sovereign on-premise AI infrastructure for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMBs / PYMEs) in Spain and Europe. Core offerings include business process automation (invoicing, CRM/ERP sync, back-office workflows) and intelligent cybersecurity operations via the SIAM SOC platform and AirGap AI (Local Galaxy).

---

## 1. Technical Capabilities & Core Products

### 1.1 AdminApp & Autonomous Invoicing Agents (VERA & QUENTIN)
- **Problem**: SMBs lose an average of 15 to 40 hours monthly on manual invoice data entry, PDF extraction, cross-referencing with delivery notes (albaranes), and bank reconciliation.
- **Solution**: Multi-modal vision and LLM extraction agents that ingest invoices via email, WhatsApp, or folder sync, validate data against existing ERP/CRM (SAP, Odoo, Sage, Holded), and generate approved accounting records in real-time.
- **Latency**: Under 3 seconds per document.
- **Accuracy**: 99.4% field extraction precision with human-in-the-loop fallback for edge cases.

### 1.2 SIAM (Security Intelligent Autonomous Monitor)
- **Problem**: 73% of SMBs lack dedicated security teams and cannot afford a traditional SOC (costing 50k€-150k€/year).
- **Solution**: Virtual SOC with autonomous event correlation, real-time threat detection, and active deceiver honeypots.
- **Key Modules**:
  - **Telemetry Correlation Engine**: Ingests WAF, Cloudflare, server logs, and endpoint telemetry.
  - **Active Defense & Honeypots**: Deploys dynamic honeypot traps (`/login`, fake phpMyAdmin, fake config.zip) to isolate bot scanners and credential-stuffing attackers, instantly triggering Cloudflare firewall mitigations.
  - **ATT&CK Kill-Chain Analysis**: Maps observed IP vectors to MITRE ATT&CK techniques with automated AI forensic summaries.

### 1.3 AirGap AI / Local Galaxy (Sovereign On-Premise Infrastructure)
- **Problem**: Regulated companies (legal, healthcare, fintech, defense) cannot upload proprietary customer records to public multi-tenant clouds (ChatGPT, Gemini API) due to GDPR / NIS2 compliance restrictions.
- **Solution**: Fully air-gapped, on-premise LLM execution running on local hardware (NVIDIA RTX / Mac Studio / dedicated Linux bare-metal).
- **Stack**: Local embedding models, high-performance vector databases (Milvus / Qdrant local), and quantized open-weights LLMs (Llama 3 / Mistral / DeepSeek) operating completely offline without external network telemetry.

## 2. Competitive Differentiators

| Criteria | Legacy Consultancy | DIY No-Code (Zapier/Make) | Praxia Labs |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Time to Value** | 60 - 180 days | 1 - 14 days (fragile) | **< 48 hours** |
| **Engineering Depth** | High overhead | Low resilience | **Production-grade TypeScript, Python, FastAPI** |
| **Data Sovereignty** | Variable | Third-party US cloud | **Full local/airgap deployment option** |
| **Pricing Model** | 10k€ - 50k€ upfront | Unpredictable per-task SaaS fees | **Transparent fixed setup + monthly SLA** |
| **Security Built-in** | Separate add-on | None | **SIAM virtual SOC & active honeypot protection** |
